acceptance_rule.primary: BITWISE: every listed arr_sha256 matches exactly (same library bytes, same data, deterministic seeds).
acceptance_rule.numerical_equivalence_fallback: If and only if bitwise fails, the reproduction is accepted as NUMERICALLY_EQUIVALENT when max|delta| <= 1e-6 on the route probabilities AND Spearman(route_repro, route_certified) >= 0.9999 AND |AUC_repro - AUC_certified| <= 1e-6 AND the eval row set hash matches.
acceptance_rule.failure: Anything outside the fallback band is REPRODUCTION_FAILED: recorded as a documented finding with exact differences; the certified champion stays immutable and finalist selection proceeds with the certified artifacts.
acceptance_rule.no_claims_rule: Bitwise parity must never be claimed unless every hash matches; numerical equivalence must never be reported as bitwise.

outputs.no_overwrite: the certified artifacts/phase17_B1/** and reports/phase17_B1_f0.json are read-only for this experiment
